title: neojapan-puroresu-1999-j1-heavyweight
label: Genji Yamato

won.source: Defeated Shoichi Mishima with a top-rope Ace Crusher at 22:56 of the tag league event's main event.

note: Covered the ring in fire-extinguisher mist and attacked a ringside attendant after winning the title.

title: neojapan-puroresu-1999-j1-heavyweight
label: Shoichi Mishima

won.source: Already champion at the earliest surviving attestation of the title; no surviving document records when or how he won it.

note: Lost the title to Genji Yamato's demonic alter-ego persona after a top-rope Ace Crusher in the tag league event's main event.

title: neojapan-puroresu-1999-j1-middleweight
label: Tasogare no Prince

won.source: Billed and honored with a ring ceremony on the tag league event's own broadcast as the wrestler who won the title back from Chris Del Rio in an American match.

note: Addressed the promotion's own president and fans on the tag league event's broadcast, thanking them for their support.

title: neojapan-puroresu-1999-j1-middleweight
label: Raptor

won.source: Billed on the tag league event's own broadcast as a former J1 Middleweight Champion; no surviving document records when or how he won it.

note: Lost the title in an American match against Chris Del Rio, a bout the tag league broadcast states Raptor himself interfered in.
